Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4; drug_indication.efo_term = 'cardiovascular disease'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
